title: Gate evidence reuse does not compare the record's profile_digest either
body: The reuse judgement tick 0dc fixed now compares the record's context_manifest_digest, but the same hole is open one field over: an evidence record also states ProfileDigest, and a resumed run whose profile configuration changed registers the would-be fingerprint (current profile) in the freshness index and publishes an old record that names the profile the attempt was dispatched under when the config said otherwise. Same shape as 0dc, same single fix site (gateEvidenceKey), but outside this tick's named scope.
